about_the_game:
The prequel novel to the game "Starnaut" arrives on Steam!

Synopsis

This is a "what if" story, set in a potential future shaped by the evolution of AI.

The year is 2059. Our protagonist, Copiasu, nervously begins reading his essay titled "The Strange Notebook." It describes many friends he's never met. Upon finishing, he thinks to himself, "I'm glad I lied this time."

"Alright, time to go home."

But wait... whose home is he going back to? A voice echoes, "Remaster." He turns around to find a mysterious girl he doesn't recognize...

A tale of blissful ignorance, known only to Copiasu.

Information

- Format: PDF

- Languages: English / Japanese

- Installation Directory: Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\STARNAUT\STARNAUT - Prologue COPIASU

short_description: Within the lore of this work, some characters possess the ability to alter their appearance based on generated prompts. Therefore, some illustrations included are based on images output by generative AI, which have then been subsequently retouched and revised by hand.
